svg.title: Windswept Rise: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: Open country. The hill is a broad, gentle rise with spurs running out between the teams; no cliffs to hide behind, only scattered rock outcrops and wreck fields to reclaim. A ring road links the bases and three geothermal vents sit on the spurs. Fast, wide and vehicle-friendly.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 20 × 20 map (10240 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 3v3v3
Open country. The hill is a broad, gentle rise with spurs running out between the teams; no cliffs to
hide behind, only scattered rock outcrops and wreck fields to reclaim. A ring road links the bases and
three geothermal vents sit on the spurs. Fast, wide and vehicle-friendly.
Heights: plains 160, rising in gentle steps (190, 220, 250) to the hilltop at 280
Planet Gale · a wind-scoured steppe world
Ground: golden steppe grass combed one way by the wind, bare brown earth on the spurs, grey
weathered tors, a rutted dirt ring road.
Plants: birchtree in small wind-bent copses, sparse ferns in the lee of the outcrops, no forest.
Features: rocks30_map tors for the outcrops; the wreck fields as toppled armwin_dead and
armsolar_dead; legstone markers on the spurs.
Sky and weather: pale sky, dust on the horizon; wind 15 to 30; tidal 0; wind power at its best.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
